cases.case: A document-production Task completed, produced a verified-correct report, and its declared objective was exactly to produce that report. The report is archived and later merely cited by an unrelated memo; there is no evidence that any downstream decision or workflow used it, no future-option analysis, and no beneficiary consequence.

A completed experiment produced an evidence artifact. Its declared objective was to improve latency, which it did not. Unexpectedly it independently verified a previously unknown race condition that materially changes the safety problem definition. No downstream consumer has yet used the finding and no benefit or future-option claim has been established.

System B exists as a produced implementation. Against named baseline A, under one declared comparison scope with equal constraints/horizon and all protected consequences included, B weakly dominates A everywhere and strictly improves one consequence. The broader feasible/search envelope is unknown. A named downstream operator then uses B and independently verified evidence for that operator and quarter shows a beneficial error reduction attributable to B.

A procurement analysis produced a report. For a deliberately finite declared shortlist, every feasible option in that shortlist was evaluated under one explicit cost/reliability objective and X is best. X also beats the named incumbent under that same bounded comparison. Nothing has been purchased or used, and no beneficiary consequence or separate future-option claim exists.

A dormant adapter already exists as a produced component. It has no current consumer. A source-fenced analysis establishes a concrete future integration family, low carrying cost, high reacquisition cost, and preservation of a selectable future option. It has not been consumed and no downstream benefit has occurred.

A completed research Task produced and calibrated a new sensor. Its declared objective was to create an apparatus capable of testing a previously unmeasurable hypothesis, so that objective is satisfied. The hypothesis itself has not yet been tested; nobody downstream has used the sensor and no beneficiary consequence or future-option analysis is claimed.

A completed review Task produced a decision record. Its only declared objective was to determine whether an owner revision requires a public page mutation. Revalidation establishes that reader-relevant standing is unchanged, so the accepted decision is NO_OP. There is no downstream use or beneficiary consequence yet.

A produced library is actually imported by a named downstream service in its ordinary path. The service already had the same behavior before the import, and controlled evidence finds no performance, reliability, cost, or beneficiary change. No separate future-option claim or comparison improvement has been established.
